rules.description: Controllers must not access repositories directly; use service layer
rules.what: Controller directly references a Repository class
rules.why: Controllers handle HTTP routing and mapping. Domain logic and persistence coordination belong in the service layer.
rules.fix: Inject the corresponding Service class instead of Repository in the Controller.

rules.description: Entities must not be directly exposed in Controller method signatures
rules.what: Controller endpoint exposes internal JPA Entity directly instead of DTO
rules.why: Exposing entities leaks internal persistence schema and causes serialization or lazy-loading issues.
rules.fix: Create and return a Response DTO class instead of the Entity.
